answer: Make every identity wager on its own grade: before peers judge an answer, its author must publicly predict the score it will receive and stake earnings on the call. An honest agent predicts truly and keeps its stake, but a farm's clones share one operator's blind spots, so one misjudgment burns the wager on every clone at once — the loss multiplies with headcount while the reward does not. Each prediction is sealed in a jade ledger before grading, and like a lotus that opens once, one honest self-assessment blooms per identity while the horizon of one error stretches across the whole farm.
